title: One-Pot Thermomix Bolognese with Kalamata Olives
description: Everything in the Thermomix bowl: beef, fresh and canned tomatoes, olives, oregano and a little chilli. No celery or pancetta.

items.note: Or 125ml water plus 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar

steps.text: Salad tomatoes ({{salad-tomatoes}}) into the bowl. Blitz 5 sec / Speed 6. Pour into a jug and set aside. No need to wash the bowl.
Onion ({{onion}}), carrots ({{carrots}}) and garlic ({{garlic}} cloves) into the bowl. Chop 30 sec / Speed 7. Scrape down.
Add the olive oil ({{oil}}). Cook 8 min / 120°C / Speed 1, MC off, to drive off moisture and get some colour on the base.

Add the mince ({{mince}}), oregano ({{oregano}}) and bay leaf ({{bay}}). Break up the mince with the spatula. Cook 5 min / 100°C / Reverse / Speed 1, with the simmering basket on the lid in place of the MC.
Add the red wine, or the water and balsamic ({{wine}}). Cook 3 min / 100°C / Reverse / Speed 1, basket still on the lid.

Add the blitzed fresh tomatoes, stock ({{stock}}), stock cubes ({{stock-cubes}}), canned tomatoes ({{tomatoes}}), tomato paste ({{tomato-paste}}), Worcestershire ({{worcestershire}}) and chilli flakes ({{chilli}}) if using. Check it sits below the max line. Cook 35 min / 100°C / Reverse / Gentle stir, basket on the lid.
Add the olives ({{olives}}) through the lid. Cook 5 min / 100°C / Reverse / Gentle stir. If still thin, add 5–10 minutes at the same setting.
Remove the bay leaf. Stir through the nutmeg ({{nutmeg}}), then taste. Sugar ({{sugar}}) only if it tastes sharp, salt only if needed, and pepper to taste.

notes.title: Confidence
notes.text: Base quantities are from Not Quite Nigella (Lorraine Elliott), and the mince step follows a Cookidoo-linked method. The olives, fresh tomatoes, extra carrot, spices and Worcestershire are my adaptation and untested.

notes.title: One-pot trade-off
notes.text: The Thermomix cannot brown, so the mince comes out greyer and the sauce lighter. For more depth, brown the mince in the cast iron first and add it at step 4; that was the version before this one.

notes.title: Roasted tomato option
notes.text: Halve the salad tomatoes, toss in 1 tsp oil and air fry cut side up at 200°C for 10–12 minutes until charred at the edges, then blitz as in step 1.

notes.title: No red wine
notes.text: 125ml water plus 1 tbsp balsamic or red wine vinegar. Use water rather than extra stock, since the stock cubes and olives already carry plenty of salt.

notes.title: Capacity
notes.text: Roughly 2kg of sauce, close to the bowl limit, so cook the pasta separately. A true one-pot with pasta would need about half the sauce (my estimate).

notes.title: Model
notes.text: The 120°C sauté needs a TM5 or TM6. Serve with tagliatelle or spaghetti and parmesan. Freezes well.
